title: Venezuelan-Style Fish Pilaf
description: A delicious fusion dish combining the flavors of Venezuela and China, featuring fish and pilaf as the main ingredients.

ingredients.name: fish
ingredients.notes: any firm white fish works well

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the fish and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
Remove the fish from the skillet and set aside.
Add the pilaf to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the jammy and dense to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the fish to the skillet and stir to coat with the pilaf mixture.
